p1_findings.root_cause: UseItem.doItem and useItem do not synchronize on player (unlike getItem), DO_THROW_ITEM lacks upper bounds checks on itemsBody/itemsBag index, and index == -1 passes -1 to MountPetItemHandler.handle -> itemBagToBody(player, -1).
p1_findings.title: Unsynchronized UseItem.doItem & Missing Index Bounds Checks

p1_findings.impact: Client can set arbitrary player.head ID or crash handler with NPE when SANTA_HEAD shop is open.
p1_findings.root_cause: `tagName.equals("SANTA_HEAD")` calls `createNewItem((short) tempId)` and assigns `player.head = (short) itS.template.head` without verifying tempId is in the shop or checking `itS.template != null`.
p1_findings.title: Unvalidated tempId in SANTA_HEAD shop allows arbitrary head spoofing or NPE

p1_findings.impact: Two concurrent connections can receive identical session.id values; SessionManager.putSession detects a duplicate key in sessionIndex and evicts the active player's session.
p1_findings.root_cause: ID_INIT++ on a plain static int is not atomic when NettySession or Session instances are constructed concurrently across threads.
p1_findings.title: Non-atomic Session ID_INIT++ causes sessionId collisions and active session eviction

p1_findings.impact: Every Netty disconnect triggers ServerManager.gI().disconnect(session) twice, risking double-decrement of IP connection counters or duplicate disconnect side effects. Also NettySession.disconnect() returns early when channel is already inactive, skipping dispose() if called post-close.
p1_findings.root_cause: NroChannelHandler.channelInactive calls Client.gI().remove(session) (which internally calls ServerManager.gI().disconnect(session) at line 154) and then calls ServerManager.gI().disconnect(session) again at line 74.
p1_findings.title: Double ServerManager.disconnect(session) invocation on Netty channelInactive

p1_findings.impact: Concurrent SimpleDateFormat usage across Netty IO threads and scheduler corrupts date strings or throws ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException/NumberFormatException inside Controller.onMessage's finally block (uncaught).
p1_findings.root_cause: Static non-thread-safe SimpleDateFormat instances (DATE_FORMAT, DAY_FORMAT) are shared without synchronization or ThreadLocal across Netty worker threads in record() and PacketProfiler-Scheduler.
p1_findings.title: Non-thread-safe SimpleDateFormat on Netty IO hot path in PacketProfiler

p1_findings.impact: Causes ConcurrentModificationException, lost server-wide VIP notifications, or corrupted ArrayList state under concurrent calls to ServerNotify.notify().
p1_findings.root_cause: notifies is a plain ArrayList modified concurrently by caller threads in notify() and polled via removeFirst() on the ServerNotify thread without synchronization.
p1_findings.title: Unsynchronized ArrayList race condition in ServerNotify.notifies

p1_findings.impact: If players leave during the loop and Client.gI().getPlayers() is a live list, players.get(i) throws IndexOutOfBoundsException, skipping player updates and aborting all Map/Zone updates for that tick.
p1_findings.root_cause: GameLoopManager.run() caches players.size() before iterating without locking or copying, and only wraps individual player.update() calls in try-catch, not players.get(i).
p1_findings.title: Unprotected list iteration in GameLoopManager.run() can skip all Zone updates

p1_findings.impact: Unauthenticated clients spamming opcode -74 (type 2) can spawn unlimited JVM threads ("SendRes-" + ip), causing Thread/OOM DoS; pre-login clients sending opcode 127 or -76 trigger NPEs.
p1_findings.root_cause: case -74 spawns a raw unbounded Thread without session auth or rate limiting; case 127 and case -76 dereference player without checking player != null.
p1_findings.title: Unauthenticated thread-spawn DoS (-74) and missing player null-checks (127, -76) in Controller

p1_findings.impact: Clearing global lists/maps in reloadData() while Netty and GameLoop threads read them causes NPE, IndexOutOfBoundsException, or ConcurrentModificationException across live sessions.
p1_findings.root_cause: reloadData() clears MAPS, ITEM_TEMPLATES, MOB_TEMPLATES, CLANS, SHOPS, NOTIFY in place without setting ServerManager.isReloading=true or synchronizing readers.
p1_findings.title: Unsafe in-place clear in Manager.reloadData() without isReloading guard or locks

p1_findings.impact: If a caller passes a negative amount or omits pre-check, currency becomes negative or increases; inconsistent with subGemAndRuby() and subGold().
p1_findings.root_cause: subRuby(int) and subGemDirect(int) subtract directly without checking num <= 0 or sufficient balance.
p1_findings.title: Inventory.subRuby() and subGemDirect() lack negative-input and underflow guards

p1_findings.impact: Thread/memory leak if player logs out during special skill, plus OS thread exhaustion under heavy special skill usage.
p1_findings.root_cause: start() allocates a new java.util.Timer per cast without synchronization, and dispose() does not call close() to cancel timer/timerTask or clear playersTaget/mobsTaget.
p1_findings.title: NewSkill leaks java.util.Timer threads and skips close() in dispose()

p1_findings.impact: ConcurrentModificationException or torn/zeroed stats when combat threads read dame/hpMax/tlDame during resetPoint().
p1_findings.root_cause: calPoint() clears and rebuilds non-synchronized ArrayLists in resetPoint()/setPointWhenWearClothes() while combat threads access NPoint without locking. Also `if (!force && !this.isDirty && (now - lastCalPointTime < 150))` still recalculates every 150ms even when !isDirty.
p1_findings.title: NPoint.calPoint() mutates non-thread-safe lists during combat reads and recalculates when !isDirty

p1_findings.impact: Any client can send ACCEPT_JOIN_CLAN with an arbitrary clanId to join any clan without an invitation and bypass the leave-clan cooldown.
p1_findings.root_cause: acceptJoinClan neither verifies a pending clan invitation nor returns when diff > 0 (lines 328-333 only send a notification and fall through into joining).
p1_findings.title: Clan join authorization and cooldown bypass in ClanService.acceptJoinClan

p1_findings.impact: With >=2 stacks totaling >2.14B items (e.g., 2B thoi vang), countItemBag overflows int negative and removeItemQuantity refuses to deduct items.
p1_findings.root_cause: countItemBag accumulates item.quantity into a 32-bit int even though addItemList allows stacks up to 2,000,000,000 (line 886).
p1_findings.title: 32-bit int overflow in InventoryService.countItemBag

p1_findings.impact: Possible NullPointerException in injured(), setDie(), kickOut(), sendMyClan(), and pet change methods; ConcurrentModificationException on Manager.CLANS.
p1_findings.root_cause: Player.injured/setDie dereference this.zone.map without null checks; ClanService.kickOut calls clan.getClanMember before checking clan != null; ClanService.sendMyClan catch logs player.clan.name when player.clan may be null; PetService accesses player.pet without null check; Manager.CLANS is iterated/mutated unsynchronized.
p1_findings.title: Missing null checks and unsynchronized Manager.CLANS access across Player/ClanService/PetService

p1_findings.impact: Clients can teleport anywhere inside the map bounds in one packet (speed/teleport hack) with zero server-side distance check.
p1_findings.root_cause: playerMove(player, x, y) clamps client-supplied (x, y) only to [24, mapWidth-24] and [24, mapHeight-24] without validating movement delta against lastTimeplayerMove or player speed.
p1_findings.title: Client-trusted coordinates in PlayerService.playerMove allow arbitrary in-map teleportation

p1_findings.impact: Concurrent revive requests can double-deduct gold/gem+ruby or revive a player twice.
p1_findings.root_cause: hoiSinh performs check-then-act on player.isDie(), lastTimeRevived, and inventory gold/gem deduction before calling Service.gI().hsChar without synchronizing on player or inventory.
p1_findings.title: Unsynchronized check-then-act in PlayerService.hoiSinh risks double-spend / double-revive

p1_findings.impact: Potential Netty ByteBuf/Message memory leak on every PlayerService.sendInfoHpMpMoney call and on exception paths in other send methods.
p1_findings.root_cause: sendInfoHpMpMoney never calls msg.cleanup() at all; sendTNSM, sendMessageAllPlayer, sendMessageIgnore, sendInfoHp, sendInfoMp, sendCurrentStamina, sendMaxStamina, and sendTypePk call msg.cleanup() outside a finally block. Conversely, SkillService.learSkillSpecial (lines 377, 382) calls message.cleanup() twice.
p1_findings.title: Missing Message.cleanup() in sendInfoHpMpMoney and non-finally cleanup paths

p1_findings.impact: SuperRank queue permanently stalls or leaks matches/memory because WaitSuperRank entries can never be removed from waitList.
p1_findings.root_cause: SuperRankManager.run() uses Iterator.remove() on waitList, which is a CopyOnWriteArrayList; CopyOnWriteArrayList iterators throw UnsupportedOperationException on remove(), and the exception is swallowed at line 55.
p1_findings.title: SuperRankManager throws UnsupportedOperationException on CopyOnWriteArrayList iterator.remove()

p1_findings.impact: Players can chat globally with 1 gem while bypass-checking 5 gems, or lose messages when listChatting is full; NPE crashes on null player arguments.
p1_findings.root_cause: chat() checks inventory.checkGemAndRuby(5) at line 75 but deducts only 1 via subGemAndRuby(1) at line 78; run() calls waitingChat.poll() before checking listChatting.size() < COUNT_CHAT, discarding queued messages; chat()/ChatGlobal dereference null player fields.
p1_findings.title: ChatGlobalService gem deduction mismatch, queue message loss, and null player NPEs

p1_findings.impact: Concurrent login during offline admin buff can overwrite player inventory/currency in DB; gem/ruby addition can overflow int to negative; invalid itemId causes NPE.
p1_findings.root_cause: buffMoney() and buffItem() load offline players via NDVSqlFetcher and call PlayerDAO.updatePlayer() without locking or checking concurrent login, add int gem/ruby without overflow bounds, and do not verify createNewItem() / bag space before adding.
p1_findings.title: AdminService offline player buff race condition, int currency overflow, and missing item checks

p1_findings.impact: Rapid OS thread exhaustion (OOM/CPU spike) and NullPointerException/IllegalArgumentException crashes in bot update loop when BotManager.ENABLED is set true.
p1_findings.root_cause: Bot.useSkill() spawns a new Thread per cast while Sanb.GetSkil() sets lastTimeSkill1 into the past causing near-continuous triggers; Sanb.GetBoss() indexes potentially empty getBosses() and null bossAttack.zone; NewBot.PARTBOT sizes array statically from Manager.ITEM_TEMPLATES.size() at class load.
p1_findings.title: Bot skill thread-spawning storm, empty-list/null-zone crashes, and static PARTBOT sizing bug

p1_findings.impact: Any client sending a spoofed submenu packet with menuId 500 (BAN) or 501 (BUFF_PET) can open the Ban Player or Buff Pet confirmation dialogs without admin privilege check in SubMenuService.
p1_findings.root_cause: SubMenuService.controller() handles `BAN` (500) and `BUFF_PET` (501) without checking `player.isAdmin()`.
p1_findings.title: Missing isAdmin() authorization check for BAN and BUFF_PET in SubMenuService.controller()

p1_findings.impact: Concurrent player actions can corrupt `ArrayDeque` internal state or throw `ConcurrentModificationException`, and double-checked locking without `volatile` can expose partially constructed singleton instances.
p1_findings.root_cause: `AntiMacroFilter.PlayerActionHistory` mutates `ArrayDeque<Long> intervals` and fields without synchronization under concurrent `evaluate()` calls; telemetry singletons use non-volatile `instance` in DCL.
p1_findings.title: Non-thread-safe ArrayDeque mutation in AntiMacroFilter and broken non-volatile DCL in telemetry singletons

p1_findings.impact: Thread-safety violation: concurrent calls from Netty/game threads can corrupt SimpleDateFormat/NumberFormat internal state, producing garbled dates/numbers or throwing ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException/NumberFormatException.
p1_findings.root_cause: Static SimpleDateFormat (dateFormat) and NumberFormat (num, numShortFormat) are used without ThreadLocal or synchronization (unlike compareDay which is synchronized).
p1_findings.title: Unsynchronized shared SimpleDateFormat and NumberFormat in Util

p1_findings.impact: Static memory leak over server uptime and potential ConcurrentModificationException/garbled logs during shutdown.
p1_findings.root_cause: THROTTLE_MAP is never evicted/bounded (keys include player context + message). During shutdown, the hook thread runs drainQueue() without stopping/joining ServerLogWorker-Thread, racing on unsynchronized WRITERS EnumMap and SimpleDateFormat instances.
p1_findings.title: Unbounded THROTTLE_MAP leak and shutdown race in Logger

p1_findings.impact: Two clans created concurrently can receive identical Clan.id values, causing primary key collisions in DB or corrupted clan lookups; concurrent clan messages can share identical message IDs.
p1_findings.root_cause: Non-atomic post-increment (NEXT_ID++ and clan.clanMessageId++) without synchronization or AtomicInteger.
p1_findings.title: Race condition on Clan.NEXT_ID and ClanMessage.id generation

p1_findings.impact: Concurrent achievement claim packets (-76, sub 1) could pass canReward(select) before reward(select) executes, potentially duplicating Hồng Ngọc (Ruby) rewards.
p1_findings.root_cause: No lock/synchronization around check-then-act (player.achievement.canReward -> reward -> addRuby).
p1_findings.title: Unsynchronized achievement reward claim in AchievementService.confirmAchievement

p1_findings.impact: Concurrent reward claims (e.g., rapid packet clicks) can pass isDone() multiple times before reset() executes at line 2139 / 2328, duplicating gold, ruby, upgrade stones, lucky wheel tickets, charms, or clan capsuleClan/memberPoint/clanPoint.
p1_findings.root_cause: paySideTask() and payClanTask() check sideTask.isDone() / clanTask.isDone(), grant all rewards, and only call reset() at the end without synchronizing on player.playerTask (or player.clan).
p1_findings.title: Missing synchronization in paySideTask() and payClanTask() allows race-condition reward duplication

p1_findings.impact: Players can gain free gold if unupgradeMagicTree() is triggered while not upgrading or via concurrent menu confirm packets.
p1_findings.root_cause: `unupgradeMagicTree()` and `fastUpgradeMagicTree()` do not check `if (!this.isUpgrade) return;`, and upgrade/unupgrade methods lack synchronization.
p1_findings.title: Missing state guard and synchronization in MagicTree upgrade/cancel

p1_findings.impact: Risk of ConcurrentModificationException or IndexOutOfBoundsException during zone mob updates or boss checks.
p1_findings.root_cause: `Zone.mobs` is a non-thread-safe `ArrayList` that is synchronized in `getTotalHP()` and `mapInfo()` but accessed without synchronization in `udMob()`, `sendBigBoss()`, and `Mob.lvMob()`.
p1_findings.title: Unsynchronized concurrent access to Zone.mobs ArrayList

p1_findings.impact: Players can drive gold negative when cooking Banh Chung/Banh Tet in NoiBanh1, and craft Banh Chung using only half the required ingredients.
p1_findings.root_cause: NoiBanh1 checks >= 20 for Thit/Nep/Dauxanh/Ladong (line 138) but subtracts only 10 (lines 145-148); neither menu checks player.inventory.gold >= 5_000_000 before executing gold -= 5000000 (lines 152, 179).
p1_findings.title: NoiBanh1 deducts wrong ingredient quantity and allows negative gold

p1_findings.impact: Concurrent Netty worker thread mutations can cause NPE, lost entries, or corrupted buckets; uncleaned keys retain Player/Item references until server restart.
p1_findings.root_cause: NpcFactory.PLAYERID_OBJECT is a plain HashMap shared across threads, and multiple menu handlers (MAKE_FRIEND, CONFIRM_NHUONG_PC, BAN_PLAYER, BUFF_PET, SUB_MENU, MENU_FIND_PLAYER, ThanVuTru) or cancelled menus never remove entries.
p1_findings.title: Non-thread-safe HashMap and memory leak in NpcFactory.PLAYERID_OBJECT

p2_p3_security_concurrency.impact: Race condition if concurrent threads ever invoke `_createImage*`, and wasted per-tick check in Main.FixedUpdate(). Also potential NRE in Main.Awake/closeKeyBoard/parse.
p2_p3_security_concurrency.root_cause: Image._createImage* and Image.update() share unsynchronized non-volatile static fields with Thread.Sleep(5) polling (though currently unused by public callers). Main.Awake doesn't set `main = this`. Main.closeKeyBoard/OnApplicationPause dereference TField.kb without null check. GameCanvas.perform case 888391 calls `int.Parse(s)` without try/catch.
p2_p3_security_concurrency.title: Unsynchronized static IPC mailbox in Image.cs and missing null/parse guards in Main/GameCanvas

p2_p3_security_concurrency.impact: If a malformed/huge SmallImage id is passed, imgNew resizes to new Small[id + 100], risking OutOfMemoryException or client crash; DataInputStream is unclosed on exception.
p2_p3_security_concurrency.root_cause: imgNew length check lacks an upper bound sanity cap; readImage closes DataInputStream inside try without finally/using.
p2_p3_security_concurrency.title: Unbounded SmallImage.imgNew resize and unclosed DataInputStream on exception

p2_p3_security_concurrency.impact: Client-side cooldown check can be bypassed if system clock moves backward; item stacking lacks overflow caps.
p2_p3_security_concurrency.root_cause: setSkillPaint() and sendUseChargeSkill() use wall-clock `mSystem.currentTimeMillis()` and explicitly reset `lastTimeUseThisSkill = num - coolDown` whenever `num < lastTimeUseThisSkill`. bagSort()/boxSort() merge `item2.quantity += item3.quantity` without max cap checks.
p2_p3_security_concurrency.title: Client skill cooldown bypass on clock rollback and uncapped client quantity merge

p2_p3_security_concurrency.impact: When an Effect removes itself at the end of its lifetime, the next Effect in vEff shifts into index i and skips its update() for that tick.
p2_p3_security_concurrency.root_cause: EffecMn.update() iterates vEff with a forward index loop (`for (int i = 0; i < vEff.size(); i++)`) while Effect.update() mutates EffecMn.vEff via removeElement(this) (Effect.cs:489, 543, 555).
p2_p3_security_concurrency.title: Forward-loop removal skips next Effect update in EffecMn.update

p2_p3_security_concurrency.impact: Built-in autoPlay teleports client position directly to mob spawn/current coordinates and sends charMove() to server, bypassing normal pathing/movement speed if server does not validate movement deltas.
p2_p3_security_concurrency.root_cause: autoPlay() assigns Char.myCharz().cx = targetX and cy = targetY directly before calling Service.gI().charMove().
p2_p3_security_concurrency.title: autoPlay() directly teleports client coordinates to mob position

p2_p3_security_concurrency.impact: Saved passwords encrypted with AES-CBC can be decrypted offline by anyone knowing deviceUniqueIdentifier and lack integrity/HMAC verification; cleartext HTTP URLs are used for update/host/web links.
p2_p3_security_concurrency.root_cause: getPasswordKey derives AES key deterministically from SHA256(SystemInfo.deviceUniqueIdentifier + "|NRO-6Tab|" + filename) without OS keystore protection or MAC; ServerListScreen/Paint hardcode http:// endpoints.
p2_p3_security_concurrency.title: Weak deterministic password key derivation in Rms and cleartext HTTP URLs

p2_p3_security_concurrency.impact: Synchronous disk I/O executes while holding rmsLock (stalling callers), rmsCache exposes mutable sbyte[] arrays directly, clearAll() deletes files outside rmsLock, and loadRMSInt crashes on 0-byte files.
p2_p3_security_concurrency.root_cause: rmsCache stores/returns raw sbyte[] references without cloning; clearAll releases rmsLock before deleting files; loadRMSInt reads array[0] without checking Length > 0; FileStream.Read return length is unchecked.
p2_p3_security_concurrency.title: Rms cache aliasing, lock-scope race on clearAll, and missing length checks

p2_p3_security_concurrency.impact: Client accelerates transport locally without sending a speed-up/gem deduction request; if server does not enforce minimum travel time or deduct Luong on transportNow(), players can bypass wait time or speed up for free.
p2_p3_security_concurrency.root_cause: perform(idAction == 2) only checks Char.myCharz().checkLuong() > 0 locally and sets isSpeed = true, then later sends Service.gI().transportNow() once currSpeed reaches threshold.
p2_p3_security_concurrency.title: TransportScr client-side Luong check and speed-up without server spend notification

p2_p3_security_concurrency.impact: If an active window closes or pushes windows during Update, UpdateKey, or Paint, windows in _activeWindows can be skipped for that frame or cause ArgumentOutOfRangeException. Also re-pushing an already open window skips OnClose().
p2_p3_security_concurrency.root_cause: UpdateKey/Update/Paint iterate _activeWindows directly by index while invoking callbacks that may mutate _activeWindows; Push removes an existing window without calling OnClose() before OnOpen().
p2_p3_security_concurrency.title: UIWindowManager mutates/iterates _activeWindows unsafely and skips OnClose on re-Push

p2_p3_security_concurrency.impact: If client_log.txt is locked by another reader on Windows, File.Move fails silently and FileMode.Create truncates the active log file. Unbounded logQueue can also grow indefinitely under log floods, and LogDir static initializer accesses Application.dataPath which fails if touched off main thread.
p2_p3_security_concurrency.root_cause: RotateLogFiles swallows all exceptions in catch {}, after which ProcessLogQueue unconditionally opens LogFilePath with FileMode.Create; logQueue has no max capacity; LogDir uses Application.dataPath in static field init.
p2_p3_security_concurrency.title: UnityLogger log rotation silently loses logs on locked file and lacks queue cap

p2_p3_security_concurrency.impact: Client contains built-in boss tracking/cheat state triggered directly from server VIP chat broadcasts.
p2_p3_security_concurrency.root_cause: Controller2 case 93 (CHAT_VIP) checks if the message starts with BOSS/Boss and calls Game1.God.BossData.getInstance().getBOSSInfo(str).
p2_p3_security_concurrency.title: Mod/cheat hook (Game1.God.BossData) embedded in Controller2 CHAT_VIP handler

p2_p3_security_concurrency.impact: `doConnect` starts `collectorThread` before `key = null`, allowing a fast `-27` key response to be wiped; `cleanNetwork` can race with streams, abort threads unsafely, and retain stale queued messages across reconnects.
p2_p3_security_concurrency.root_cause: Thread startup and teardown lack synchronization, `key = null` is placed after thread start, and `recieveMsg`/`sendingMessage` are not cleared in `cleanNetwork`.
p2_p3_security_concurrency.title: Unsynchronized Session Startup/Teardown and Stale Queues on Reconnect

p2_p3_security_concurrency.impact: Client controls and sends its own position, flying MP deduction, target coords, and arbitrary byte blobs (`sendOptHat`, `sendServerData`), enabling speed/teleport/skill-range exploits if server trusts them.
p2_p3_security_concurrency.root_cause: `charMove` computes MP locally and sends `cx`/`cy`, `new_skill_not_focus` sends self and target coords, and `sendOptHat(1)`/`sendServerData` upload unvalidated client byte arrays.
p2_p3_security_concurrency.title: Client-Trusted Coordinates, Local MP Deduction, and Raw Byte Uploads

p2_p3_security_concurrency.impact: Client mod exposes unguarded client-side teleportation, 100x game speedhack, and arbitrary movement speed override (`speedRun`), relying entirely on server-side validation.
p2_p3_security_concurrency.root_cause: `Mobs.GotoXY` and `Utils.Teleport` mutate `cx/cy` directly and send `charMove()`; `ClientManager` allows `gameSpeed` up to `100f` via `cheat` chat and unclamped `speedRun`; `nSkill` sends attacks up to `1.7 * dx/dy` reach without checking mana or updating char skill animation.
p2_p3_security_concurrency.title: Client-side teleport, speedhack, and extended-reach auto-attack in God mods

p2_p3_security_concurrency.impact: Stale `isFriendAccep` flag from a prior trade can persist into a new trade; 32-bit `int` limits trade gold representation to ~2.14B.
p2_p3_security_concurrency.root_cause: `setTypeGiaoDich` resets `isAccept`, `isLock`, `isFriendLock`, `moneyGD`, `friendMoneyGD`, `vMyGD`, `vFriendGD`, but omits resetting `isFriendAccep = false`. `moneyGD` and `friendMoneyGD` are `int` rather than `long`.
p2_p3_security_concurrency.title: Trade state reset omits isFriendAccep and uses 32-bit int for trade gold

p2_p3_security_concurrency.impact: Client allows sending 0 or negative trade xu amounts if entered via text/clipboard, relying solely on server rejection.
p2_p3_security_concurrency.root_cause: onChatFromMe trade money branch only checks num2 > Char.myCharz().xu and never checks num2 <= 0.
p2_p3_security_concurrency.title: Missing <= 0 validation for trade money input in onChatFromMe

p2_p3_security_concurrency.impact: Username sent in plaintext over unencrypted HTTP and unescaped in query string; exception in platformRequest is silently discarded.
p2_p3_security_concurrency.root_cause: doFireAccount() case 4 builds an http:// URL by raw string concatenation with GameCanvas.loginScr.tfUser.getText() without HTTPS or URL encoding, and catch only calls ex.StackTrace.ToString().
p2_p3_security_concurrency.title: Cleartext HTTP URL with raw username concatenation and swallowed exception in doFireAccount

p2_p3_security_concurrency.impact: Removing a PopUp inside command.performAction() skips the next PopUp in vPopups during that update tick.
p2_p3_security_concurrency.root_cause: PopUp.updateAll() iterates vPopups forward (for i = 0; i < vPopups.size(); i++) while update() executes command.performAction(), which may mutate vPopups via removePopUp().
p2_p3_security_concurrency.title: Forward iteration over vPopups during updateAll() vulnerable to element skipping on removal

p2_p3_security_concurrency.impact: Can throw IndexOutOfBoundsException in AnTrom.update() on disconnect race, and skip/double-update bosses in BossManager.update().
p2_p3_security_concurrency.root_cause: AnTrom.update() reads `players.size()` and then calls `players.get(Util.nextInt(playerCount))` on the live player list without synchronization; BossManager.update() uses reverse index iteration over CopyOnWriteArrayList which is not atomic against concurrent removals.
p2_p3_security_concurrency.title: Unsafe concurrent list indexing in AnTrom.update() and BossManager.update()

p2_p3_security_concurrency.impact: If a pet/clone/bot (negative ID) deals the killing blow to TuanLoc or LanCon, Math.abs(plAtt.id) assigns escort/reward ownership to the positive-ID player (or wrong player), and null plAtt causes NPE.
p2_p3_security_concurrency.root_cause: `this.playerId = Math.abs(plAtt.id);` does not verify `plAtt != null && plAtt.isPl()`, allowing negative-ID non-player entities to claim/trigger reward escort.
p2_p3_security_concurrency.title: TuanLoc and LanCon assign reward playerId via Math.abs(plAtt.id) without isPl()/null checks

p2_p3_security_concurrency.impact: NullPointerException in DeathBeam.attack() if playerAtt leaves map/disconnects so playerAtt.zone becomes null; NhanBan.joinMap() and DeathOrAliveArena.joinMap() also dereference playerAtt without null checks.
p2_p3_security_concurrency.root_cause: DeathBeam checks `!playerAtt.zone.equals(this.zone)` without `playerAtt.zone != null`, and `joinMap()` accesses `parentBoss.zone` / `playerAtt.zone` without null checks.
p2_p3_security_concurrency.title: Missing null checks on playerAtt.zone, playerAtt, and parentBoss in DeathBeam, NhanBan, and DeathOrAliveArena

p2_p3_security_concurrency.impact: If player HP exceeds ~429B (TaoPaiPai) or ~21B-42B (Yardart), or Whis training level is high, boss damage/HP overflows int/long and can wrap negative. SuperRank voHieuChuong recovery also overflows int when damage * voHieuChuong / 100 > Integer.MAX_VALUE.
p2_p3_security_concurrency.root_cause: Long HP/damage calculations are cast down to (int) without clamping before cast, and Whis multiplies hpMax and dame by level without overflow guard.
p2_p3_security_concurrency.title: Int truncation/overflow in boss damage and scaling calculations

p2_p3_security_concurrency.impact: Can throw IndexOutOfBoundsException or ConcurrentModificationException on boss tick when players connect/disconnect concurrently, and NPE/IndexOutOfBoundsException if mapId 0..44 has null map or empty zones.
p2_p3_security_concurrency.root_cause: handleMapChange() reads Client.gI().getPlayers().size() then indexes players.get(Util.nextInt(playerCount)) without locking/snapshot; changeToRandomMap() indexes zones.get(0) without null/empty check.
p2_p3_security_concurrency.title: Unsafe concurrent player list indexing and unchecked zone access in ThoDaiKa

p2_p3_security_concurrency.impact: Memory leak in PVPManager and permanently locked player.pvp state if either player disconnects during the 3-second TraThu delay, plus potential ConcurrentModificationException on p1.enemies.
p2_p3_security_concurrency.root_cause: TraThu.start() schedules super.start() 3s later on GameLoopManager; if the disconnect check fails, dispose() is never called. sendResult() iterates and removes from p1.enemies without synchronization and calls p1.equals(plLose) without null checks.
p2_p3_security_concurrency.title: TraThu 3-second scheduled start leaks PVP on disconnect and iterates p1.enemies unsafely

p2_p3_security_concurrency.impact: Potential truncation if player IDs exceed 32-bit int max or if SuperRank topList ever exceeds 127 entries; tournament gold fees stored in int instead of long.
p2_p3_security_concurrency.root_cause: Message writes (int) sb.getId() / (int) boss.id and byte list.size(); WorldMartialArtsTournamentService stores tournamentGolds[tour] in int.
p2_p3_security_concurrency.title: int narrowing on player/boss IDs, byte list size, and int gold variable

p2_p3_security_concurrency.impact: Concurrent readers of Manager.ACHIEVEMENT_TEMPLATE during admin reload can hit ConcurrentModificationException or see an empty list mid-reload.
p2_p3_security_concurrency.root_cause: reloadAchievementTemplate() calls Manager.ACHIEVEMENT_TEMPLATE.clear() and addAll(list) without synchronization or atomic reference swap.
p2_p3_security_concurrency.title: Unsynchronized in-place clear/addAll on Manager.ACHIEVEMENT_TEMPLATE during reload

p2_p3_security_concurrency.impact: Values exceeding int/short/byte bounds (e.g., BIGINT/long stats, currency, or quantities) silently wrap/truncate instead of throwing, risking stat or currency corruption.
p2_p3_security_concurrency.root_cause: getByte, getShort, and getInt cast any Number and call byteValue()/shortValue()/intValue() without range checking.
p2_p3_security_concurrency.title: Silent numeric truncation in getByte/getShort/getInt on Number values

p2_p3_security_concurrency.impact: Invalid KeyHandler.setKey length <= 0 causes NegativeArraySizeException or ArithmeticException (/ by zero); sendImageByName validates ^[a-zA-Z0-9_]+$ properly, while CommandRegistry legacy fallback executes outside try-catch and buffmoney silently truncates long gem/ruby to int.
p2_p3_security_concurrency.root_cause: Missing bounds/try-catch checks on KeyHandler.setKey byte length, CommandRegistry legacy prefix dispatch and (int) cast in buffmoney, and Command.java 'm '/'i ' admin chat commands.
p2_p3_security_concurrency.title: Uncaught legacy command dispatch, int truncation in buffmoney, and missing input validation in KeyHandler/Command

p2_p3_security_concurrency.impact: ConcurrentHashMap.computeIfAbsent throws NPE if MySession.ipAddress is null; NettySession.enqueueMessage calls O(N) ConcurrentLinkedQueue.size() on every incoming packet; AutoBtri uses non-volatile isRunning and non-thread-safe singleton.
p2_p3_security_concurrency.root_cause: Missing null check on ipAddress before ANTILOGIN.computeIfAbsent; ConcurrentLinkedQueue.size() traversal on hot inbound path; missing volatile/synchronized in AutoBtri.
p2_p3_security_concurrency.title: Minor concurrency and null-safety hazards in MySession, NettySession, and AutoBtri

p2_p3_security_concurrency.impact: Other threads reading Maintenance.isRunning may observe stale false values due to missing volatile; two concurrent start() calls can throw IllegalThreadStateException; start(int min) actually treats argument as seconds.
p2_p3_security_concurrency.root_cause: isRunning lacks volatile, start() lacks synchronization, and countdown loop decrements time by 1 per 1000ms despite parameter name `min`.
p2_p3_security_concurrency.title: Non-volatile Maintenance.isRunning and seconds/minutes unit mismatch

p2_p3_security_concurrency.impact: All players joining a map serialize on the Controller singleton lock while executing DB queries, mapInfo, and Netty sends; sendInfo also executes blocking SuperRankDAO JDBC queries on Netty thread.
p2_p3_security_concurrency.root_cause: handleClientJoinMap is declared `synchronized` on Controller.gI() instead of per-player synchronization; sendInfo performs synchronous SuperRankDAO calls on packet thread.
p2_p3_security_concurrency.title: Global Controller singleton lock in handleClientJoinMap and blocking DAO in sendInfo

p2_p3_security_concurrency.impact: Mixed-case ignored names bypass IGNORE_NAME check; negative byte in combine (-81) throws NegativeArraySizeException; duplicate/non-atomic check-then-insert on createChar.
p2_p3_security_concurrency.root_cause: createChar compares mixed-case name against DB and ConstIgnoreName before calling name.toLowerCase() during insert; case -81 passes readByte() directly as array length without >= 0 validation.
p2_p3_security_concurrency.title: Input validation & case-normalization mismatch in Controller createChar and Combine (-81)

p2_p3_security_concurrency.impact: Registered players can be dropped at round boundaries; ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException if getTournament() returns -1 during reward().
p2_p3_security_concurrency.root_cause: update() iterates and clears listReg/listWait without locking against concurrent registration threads and indexes ConstTournament.tournamentNames[WorldMartialArtsTournamentService.getTournament()] without checking for -1.
p2_p3_security_concurrency.title: WorldMartialArtsTournamentManager registration list race and negative tournament index crash

p2_p3_security_concurrency.impact: Deleting consign items via Admin API can throw ConcurrentModificationException or diverge from DB; invalid bossId truncation if id exceeds int32; invalid giftcode detail JSON persisted to DB.
p2_p3_security_concurrency.root_cause: ConsignHandler POST remove mutates ConsignShopManager without synchronization and ignores DB DELETE errors; GET indexes ITEM_TEMPLATES without bounds check; BossActionHandler reads bossId as int; GiftCodesHandler persists detail JSON before validation.
p2_p3_security_concurrency.title: AdminApiService unsynchronized consign removal, unchecked template indexing, and unvalidated giftcode JSON

p2_p3_security_concurrency.impact: Concurrent calls to getFlagsForChooseClan() can corrupt flagClan list or add null elements causing NPE in sendListFlagClan().
p2_p3_security_concurrency.root_cause: Lazy initialization of ArrayList flagClan is unsynchronized and adds getFlagBag(flagsId[i]) without null filtering.
p2_p3_security_concurrency.title: FlagBagService unsynchronized lazy initialization and possible null FlagBag entry

p2_p3_security_concurrency.impact: If an `Error` (e.g., OOM) occurs in `HttpClient.sendAsync`, `whenComplete` throws a secondary `ClassCastException`; `MemoryOptimizer` can trigger premature server shutdown/exit while Netty/game loops are still mutating player state.
p2_p3_security_concurrency.root_cause: `CloudTelemetryStreamer` casts `(Exception) throwable` inside `whenComplete`; `MemoryOptimizer` evaluates heap thresholds without post-GC verification and calls `saveAllPlayersData()` + `System.exit(0)` without stopping `ServerManager`/Netty first.
p2_p3_security_concurrency.title: Unsafe Throwable cast in CloudTelemetryStreamer and unsafe mid-flight restart in MemoryOptimizer

p2_p3_security_concurrency.impact: Accounts with malformed BCrypt hashes or unmigrated hashes fall back to plaintext password comparison.
p2_p3_security_concurrency.root_cause: verifyPassword catches Exception around BCrypt.checkpw and falls back to password.equals(hashed), and also accepts non-BCrypt strings via plaintext equality.
p2_p3_security_concurrency.title: Plaintext password fallback in PasswordUtils.verifyPassword

p2_p3_security_concurrency.impact: Global fusion/skill constants could be accidentally mutated at runtime across threads without synchronization.
p2_p3_security_concurrency.root_cause: HOP_THE_PORATA2, HOP_THE_PORATA3, and TimeUseSkill are declared `public static` without `final`.
p2_p3_security_concurrency.title: Non-final mutable static fields in ConstPlayer and ConstHocKyNang

p2_p3_security_concurrency.impact: IndexOutOfBoundsException if another thread removes an element from membersInGame or clanMessages between size() and get(i); CopyOnWriteArrayList copies the backing array on every add(0, cmg) and remove(i).
p2_p3_security_concurrency.root_cause: Index-based reverse iteration over CopyOnWriteArrayList instead of enhanced for-loop or concurrent deque.
p2_p3_security_concurrency.title: Unsafe index-based iteration on CopyOnWriteArrayList in Clan

p2_p3_security_concurrency.impact: Players can interact with and confirm menus for almost any NPC from anywhere in the map without being near them.
p2_p3_security_concurrency.root_cause: canOpenNpc checks (Util.getDistance(...) <= 60 || !MapService.gI().isMapBlackBallWar(mapId)), which bypasses the 60-unit distance check on every non-BlackBallWar map.
p2_p3_security_concurrency.title: Npc.canOpenNpc bypasses distance check on all non-BlackBallWar maps

p2_p3_security_concurrency.impact: Race condition on Calick map/npcs list and GhiDanh.menuSelect under concurrent player interactions.
p2_p3_security_concurrency.root_cause: Calick.changeMap mutates shared map.npcs and coordinates without synchronization; GhiDanh stores per-player menuSelect array in a shared Npc instance field.
p2_p3_security_concurrency.title: Unsynchronized shared state in Calick and GhiDanh NPCs

p2_p3_security_concurrency.impact: Potential NullPointerException if WorldMartialArtsTournamentManager.gI().chatText is null before loop header executes.
p2_p3_security_concurrency.root_cause: For-loop condition calls chatText.size() before checking chatText != null inside the loop body.
p2_p3_security_concurrency.title: Null check placed after .size() in NonInteractiveNPC.update

p2_p3_security_concurrency.impact: Players can enable offline auto-training for free without having or spending 1 gem.
p2_p3_security_concurrency.root_cause: Menu option 1 advertises "Đồng ý\n1 ngọc\nmỗi lần", but confirmMenu sets player.dangKyTapTuDong = true without checking or deducting gem.
p2_p3_security_concurrency.title: Auto-training registration does not check or deduct advertised 1 gem cost

p2_p3_security_concurrency.impact: Concurrent setWeather and Zone.mapInfo reads can throw ConcurrentModificationException; broadcastWeatherToMap resends full map info (-24) to all players in all zones.
p2_p3_security_concurrency.root_cause: WeatherService stores plain ArrayLists in activeWeatherMap/Map.effMap and mutates them in setWeather without synchronization.
p2_p3_security_concurrency.title: Unsynchronized list mutation in WeatherService.setWeather

p2_p3_security_concurrency.impact: Potential NPE if clan is null, and non-leader or forged menu state could trigger clan deletion if reached.
p2_p3_security_concurrency.root_cause: CONFIRM_DISSOLUTION_CLAN calls clan.deleteDB(clan.id) without null-checking player.clan or verifying clan.isLeader(player).
p2_p3_security_concurrency.title: Missing null and leader check in CONFIRM_DISSOLUTION_CLAN

p2_p3_security_concurrency.impact: If `wrong()` is invoked 128+ times without resetting (e.g., if caller doesn't gate on `canLogin()`), `wrongLogin` wraps to -128 (`< MAX_WRONG`), bypassing the brute-force login lockout. Public visibility also permits unsynchronized external mutation.
p2_p3_security_concurrency.root_cause: `wrongLogin` is declared `public byte wrongLogin` and incremented unboundedly (`wrongLogin++`) in `wrong()`. Also `timeCanLogin` (line 8) is dead state (written, never read).
p2_p3_security_concurrency.title: AntiLogin.wrongLogin uses signed byte that can overflow and is public non-volatile

client_core_render_audio__p01: Main.cs mixes three Unity callbacks for core state: FixedUpdate() drives Rms.update(), GameCanvas.update(), Image.update(), DataInputStream.update() via a gameSpeedAccumulator loop; Update() drives Session_ME.update() and Session_ME2.update(); OnGUI() drives checkInput() and GameCanvas.paint(g).

Image.cs contains an unsynchronized single-slot static IPC mailbox (status, imgTemp, filenametemp, datatemp, imgSrcTemp, xtemp, ytemp, wtemp, htemp, transformtemp) polled with Thread.Sleep(5) up to 500x in private _createImage* methods and serviced in Image.update() on the main thread; status is non-volatile and lacks locking, though public createImage methods currently bypass it and call __createImage directly.

Main.Awake() checks `if (main != null)` to destroy duplicate MonoBehaviours, but `main = this` is only assigned later inside FixedUpdate()->setsizeChange() after `count >= 10`, leaving a 10-tick window where duplicate Main instances are not destroyed.

GameCanvas.cs holds ~90 mutable static globals (currentScreen, currentDialog, panel, panel2, keyPressed/keyHold/keyReleased, pointer flags, imgBG/yb/bgW/bgH) accessed across Main.OnGUI, Main.FixedUpdate, and action callbacks without synchronization.
client_core_render_audio__p02: Sound.status (non-volatile static int) is read/written across main and background threads in Sound._load/_start/_stop with Thread.Sleep(5) spin-wait up to 500ms, while Sound.update() is empty so status is never reset inside Sound.cs.

Sound.player[] stores the same 'Audio Player 1' GameObject in every slot while __load calls AddComponent<AudioSource>() per slot; GetComponent<AudioSource>() in __start/__stop always returns the first AudioSource (SoundBGLoop).
mGraphics holds mutable static caches (cachedTextures, color1x1Cache) cleared wholesale on threshold (>400 / >300) via UnityEngine.Object.Destroy inside render calls.
mGraphics instance state (isClip, isTranslate, translateX/Y, translateXf/Yf, r/g/b/a) is mutated during OnGUI; reset() clears translateX/Y but does not reset translateXf/Yf or r/g/b/a.

SmallImage uses static arrays (imgbig, imgNew, smallImg) and MyVector (vt_images_watingDowload) mutated lazily during paint() via createImage() and periodically evicted every 1000 gameTicks in update().
client_gameplay_entities__p01: Static shared EffectData fields on boss classes (BigBoss.data, BachTuoc.data, BigBoss2.data, Mabu.data1/data2) overwrite across instances or partial loads.
